name: Slumber
description: Sleep tracking with nothing to start at bedtime. Slumber runs in the background and finds your sleep from wrist movement and heart rate at any hour, so a late night or a sleep-in is never missed or cut short. It reports when you slept and how long you rested, not sleep stages, which a wrist cannot measure reliably. Everything stays on the watch. Install Slumber Glance too: it puts last night on a card in the glance carousel.
